description: This file contains a benchmark class for testing Orleans' map-reduce capabilities, including setup, execution, and cleanup of complex processing pipelines using Orleans grains and the BenchmarkDotNet library.

classes.name: MapReduceBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmark class for testing Orleans map-reduce operations with complex processing pipelines, including setup, execution, and cleanup.

methods.name: BenchmarkSetup
methods.description: Initializes the test cluster before benchmarking begins.

methods.name: Bench
methods.description: Executes the main benchmarking task asynchronously, running multiple pipelines in parallel.

methods.name: Teardown
methods.description: Stops all silos in the test cluster after benchmarking.

methods.name: BenchCore
methods.description: Performs the core map-reduce pipeline setup and execution, including grain initialization and message passing.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the test cluster resources.
